description: A singleton class modeling the <entity-config> element in the OFBiz framework, responsible for loading and providing access to entity configuration data from 'entityengine.xml'.

classes.name: EntityConfig
classes.description: Singleton class that loads and provides access to entity configuration data from 'entityengine.xml'.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EntityConfig.
